title: sparcproteomics: engine-agnostic downstream analysis of quantitative proteomics data
description: R package for downstream analysis of quantitative proteomics data from DIA-NN, Spectronaut, MaxQuant, DIA-NN precursor reports, peptide tables or a generic matrix: configurable species, groups, comparisons, normalization, imputation and statistics (limma, Welch, Student, TREAT), presence/absence testing, optional Reactome enrichment and AI interpretation. Benchmarked on PXD028735.
